# Recreation Prompt

Create a single-file browser game called **Spartan Shieldfall Arena**. Preserve the mechanics of a bubble shooter: the player aims from the bottom of a portrait playfield, taps/clicks to fire one projectile at a time, projectiles bounce off side walls, snap to a staggered grid, clear connected clusters of three or more matching types, award bonus points for detached floating clusters, and end the run when the grid reaches the lower breach zone. Reinterpret all presentation as a clean military sci-fi alien-war arena: a super-soldier gauntlet cannon, alien shield-frequency nodes, an orbital ring battlefield, carrier/drone silhouettes, Valor score HUD, breach-line warning, and mobile-readable start/restart panels. Use browser-native CSS/Canvas/JavaScript with catalog-backed sci-fi audio and fonts; do not add new combat mechanics, health, enemies, or scoring rules.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
The preserved source is a canvas bubble-shooter. The player aims from the bottom of the screen with pointer/touch movement, fires one projectile at a time, bounces shots off side walls, snaps projectiles into a staggered hex-like grid, clears connected clusters of three or more matching colors, awards bonus points for detached floating clusters, and loses when the lattice reaches the lower danger rows. Start, game-over, restart, score HUD, particles, audio, and mobile touch paths are present.

## Protected Mechanics
- Aim follows cursor/touch over the playfield.
- Tap/click fires only when the game is active and no projectile is in flight.
- Projectile speed remains 15 and wall-bounce/ceiling-snap behavior is preserved.
- Grid coordinate, neighbor, cluster, and floating-cluster rules are retained.
- Score remains cluster size times 10 plus 20 per detached floating node.
- Loss remains the lower-row breach check after a non-matching placement.

## Remixed Target
`Spartan Shieldfall Arena` reframes the same loop as a portrait military sci-fi shield firefight. The player is a super-soldier operating a gauntlet cannon in an orbital alien-war arena. Bubbles become alien shield frequencies, matching clusters become shield collapses, floating clusters become severed carrier links, score becomes Valor, and failure becomes a breach of the firing deck.

## Safe Theming Surfaces
HUD vocabulary, panel copy, title, palette, procedural entity rendering, background motifs, particles, audio catalog choices, feedback labels, and mobile hierarchy are safe to transform because they do not alter input, movement, collision, scoring, or fail semantics.
